translations.web: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
translations.bsb: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like foliage.
translations.kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
translations.asv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; But the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
